column1: # Historical hashes live only in the disposable payload. They let a later run
# distinguish an unmodified file previously shipped by this project from a
# user-edited file without leaving a receipt or marker on the machine.
# Assets adopted from an existing machine (currently the agent skill) also list
# the pristine pre-adoption version, so a host that already carries it upgrades
# instead of being reported as an unresolvable user edit.
